seo.title: Zynthian: plugin-hostd as its plugin host — OpenMixer
seo.description: Zynthian running its LV2 and CLAP plugins under plugin-hostd: what it is, the measured figures with their date, and where the changes to Zynthian stand. The full use case is on the plugin-hostd pages.

hero.title: Zynthian: plugin-hostd as its plugin host.
hero.lede: A short summary. The full use case, with every figure and capture, is published by plugin-hostd itself and linked at the end of this page.

what.title: What it is.
what.p1: Zynthian is an open synthesizer and effects platform on a Raspberry Pi. It runs LV2 plugins through jalv, and through mod-host behind MOD-UI. plugin-hostd speaks mod-host's socket protocol and runs each plugin, LV2 or CLAP, in a worker process of its own, so a plugin that crashes takes down its own worker, which is put back with its settings, and nothing else.
what.p2: With it Zynthian gets a plugin-hostd engine for LV2 and CLAP plugins in chains, plugin-hostd as a switchable replacement for mod-host under MOD-UI, plugin menus ordered from per-plugin qualification records, and chains whose plugins the daemon groups into as few workers as it can.

figures.title: The headline figures.
figures.intro: One measurement on a Raspberry Pi 5 running Zynthian, published 2026-10-27: a chain of plugins in one worker against one process per plugin, plugin-hostd 0.12.0 with omx-clap-host 0.22.1, 256 frames at 48 and 96 kHz.
figures.pss: Memory: with 16 plugins, proportional memory (PSS) is 2.8x smaller grouped, 42.9 MB against 118.2 MB at 48 kHz.
figures.cpu: CPU: 1.2 to 1.9x less when grouped, across 3, 8 and 16 plugins.
figures.xruns: Xruns over 12 runs of each mode: 10 grouped against 41 with one process per plugin; few and unevenly spread, so a count and not a rate.
figures.more: Every row, the method and what was not measured

series.title: Where the changes to Zynthian stand.
series.forks: Checked 2026-10-28. The engine and the system changes are carried on FreeMixer's forks of zynthian-ui and zynthian-sys: eleven changes merged in zynthian-ui (the plugin-hostd engine, plugin-hostd by default with a snapshot converter, menus from qualification, chains from the daemon's planner), and seven merged with one open in zynthian-sys (the OpenMixer repository, plugin-hostd as the mod-host of MOD-UI, MOD GUIs from omx-panel, OpenMixer in the default install).
series.upstream: Upstream, one change is proposed so far: zynthian-sys pull request 228, building MOD-UI's environment on Python 3.13, open. The rest has not been proposed to Zynthian's maintainers yet.
